info.title: Clarian API
info.description: Customer-facing API for the Clarian B2B crypto/PIX platform. Every route below lives under /v1/{env}/ and is reached with an API key (or, for a handful of owner/admin dashboard actions, a Better Auth session). Wallets, PIX on/off-ramp, OTC/RFQ, KYC, webhooks, payment links and multi-tenant wallet-as-a-service sub-accounts. Rate limit: 120 requests per minute per API key (fixed one-minute window); over it the reply is 429 `rate_limited`, retry after the window resets. Amounts are integer minor units as strings: BRL scale 2 (R$ 10,00 = "1000"), USDT/USDC scale 6.

post.description: Starts a PIX cash-out and debits the amount plus fee at once. With an API key the money goes to the workspace's registered settlement key, whatever `pix_key` says (`pix_key` is still required). A workspace with no settlement key gets 403 `settlement_key_required`; the owner registers one in the dashboard. Send `Idempotency-Key`: a retry with the same key returns the same payment and never pays twice. Errors: `insufficient_balance`, `pix_key_required`, `settlement_key_required`, `kyc_not_approved` (live).

amount_minor.description: Gross amount in the coin's minor units (scale 6).

post.description: Sent when a PIX payin/payout, crypto send, or RFQ settlement reaches status completed. Signed with HMAC-SHA256: the endpoint's secret signs the string `${x-clarian-timestamp}.${raw request body}`; the hex digest is sent as `x-clarian-signature`. Verify by recomputing the HMAC over the exact bytes received and comparing with a constant-time check. `x-clarian-timestamp` is the send time of this attempt (ISO-8601), so a retry carries a fresh one; the body's `created_at` stays the event time; `x-clarian-event` repeats the event type. The JSON body is `{id, type, created_at, data}`, where `data` is the payload below. Delivery retries on a non-2xx response.

amount_minor.description: Integer minor units, as a string.

200.description: Any 2xx response marks the delivery as delivered.

ApiKeyAuth.description: `Authorization: Bearer cl_test_sk_...` (sandbox) or `Bearer cl_live_sk_...` (live). A live key additionally needs production enabled by the workspace owner. Using a live key against the sandbox path revokes it on sight (leak signal); a sandbox key on live is refused and logged, but not revoked.

WorkspaceIdHeader.name: X-Workspace-Id
WorkspaceIdHeader.description: The workspace (tenant) UUID. Always required, including on session-authenticated dashboard calls.

EnvPath.name: env
EnvPath.description: `test` is also accepted on the wire as an alias of `sandbox`; the key prefix must match (cl_test_sk_ for sandbox/test, cl_live_sk_ for live).

SubaccountHeader.name: X-Subaccount-Id
SubaccountHeader.description: Wallet-as-a-service: act on one of the caller's own sub-accounts (its ledger, parties and wallets) instead of the workspace itself. Only valid on balances/wallets/transactions/statement/crypto/pix/payment-links/rfq routes, only for a workspace-level caller (not a party-scoped key), and only for a sub-account the caller's workspace owns.

IdempotencyKeyRequired.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKeyRequired.description: Required. The same key with the same request body replays the stored result; the same key with a different body is 409 idempotency_key_reuse.

IdempotencyKeyOptional.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKeyOptional.description: Optional here. When sent, the same key with the same request body replays the stored result; a different body is 409 idempotency_key_reuse.

OtpHeader.name: X-OTP-Code
OtpHeader.description: A fresh TOTP code. Required only when the caller authenticated with a dashboard session (Better Auth cookie) that has two-factor enabled; ignored for a plain API-key call, which this step-up check never sees. Missing/invalid returns 422 {"error":"otp_required"|"otp_invalid"} (or passkey_required/passkey_invalid for a passkey-step-up account).

Error.description: Every error from this API has this exact shape (`Http.err` / `Http.errMsg`).

message.description: Present only on a subset of errors; human-readable detail.

Payment.description: A payment intent / ledger-facing operation: a PIX cash-in or cash-out, a crypto send, or an RFQ settlement. Exact fields vary by `kind`.

party_id.description: The customer (or workspace entity) this payment belongs to.

kind.description: pix_in | pix_out | crypto_send | convert (RFQ) — other internal kinds may appear.

amount_minor.description: Integer minor units, as a string (BRL scale 2; USDT/USDC scale 6).

fee_minor.description: Fee in the payment currency's minor units, as a string.

network.description: e.g. polygon, base, ethereum, tron, solana.

Customer.description: A party of kind customer. Fields mirror CreateCustomerRequest plus server-assigned ones.

enabled.description: When true, a crypto send may only target an address already on the whitelist.

unlistedMaxUsdCents.description: USD cents. A single send at or under it may go to an address off the list; null = none.

PayoutAccount.description: A saved PIX withdrawal destination. Starts `unconfirmed`; the first payout initiate confirms it.

events.description: Comma-separated event types, or `*` for every event.

secret.description: The signing secret, in cleartext. Shown exactly once — there is no route that reads it back.

amount_minor.description: 0 when the link has no fixed price (open-amount).

share_bps.description: Basis points of the charge; every link's shares sum to at most 10000.

SubAccount.description: A child workspace (wallet-as-a-service tenant). One level only — a sub-account cannot have its own sub-account.

ApiKey.description: Never carries the secret — only the hash is stored; `key_prefix` is shown for the owner to tell keys apart.

key_prefix.description: First 14 characters of the secret, e.g. `cl_live_sk_abc1`.

secret.description: The raw key (e.g. `cl_live_sk_...`). Shown exactly once.

event.description: e.g. api_key.created, api_key.updated, api_key.rotated, api_key.revoked, workspace_mismatch, prod_key_on_sandbox_revoked, prod_key_on_sandbox_replay, api_key_sandbox_on_production.

settings.description: Freeform, workspace-chosen preferences. Feature flags are not here (staff-only).

StatementLine.description: One ledger posting on the workspace's own accounts (intercompany/system accounts excluded).

direction.description: From the customer's point of view: a debit raises their balance.

amount_minor.description: Integer minor units, always positive; `direction` carries the sign.

Balance.description: One ledger balance bucket (currency x kind) for the caller's workspace or party.

balance_minor.description: Integer minor units, as a string. Divide by 10^scale to display.

scale.description: Decimal places of the currency: BRL 2, USDT/USDC 6, BTC/ETH 8.

PayableNetwork.description: A network the caller can currently send crypto from (gas and provider support considered).

Price.description: Provider-sourced quote for one symbol. Shape is provider-defined; keys below are typical.

Quote.description: An RFQ quote. `quote_id`/`id` is what POST /rfq/execute takes back.

quote_amount_minor.description: What you receive, in quote_currency minor units, after fees.

rate.description: Decimal rate as a string, quote units per base unit.

fee_minor.description: Total fee, in fee_currency minor units (spread plus fixed fee).

PixFeeQuote.description: What a PIX withdrawal costs before sending — the same schedule the actual payout holds.

fee_minor.description: The fee for this amount, under the workspace's PIX-out schedule.

debit_minor.description: What the ledger locks: amount plus fee when the merchant bears it.

sent_minor.description: What is actually sent to the receiver: amount minus fee when the payer bears it.

max_minor.description: The largest amount_minor whose debit still fits budget_minor, if that was sent.

PixDictResult.description: DICT key resolution. The provider has no standalone lookup endpoint — this answers 501 dict_lookup_unsupported outside the mock provider; a real payout resolves the receiver when it initiates instead.

PublicCheckout.description: What an unauthenticated buyer page may see about a payment link.

network.description: polygon | base | ethereum | tron | solana, etc. Accepts `wallet_name`/`walletName` and `is_primary`/`isPrimary` aliases too.

address.description: Only when the caller supplies its own key material; otherwise one is provisioned.

party_id.description: Required unless the key is already party-scoped or the workspace has one default entity party.

amount_minor.description: Integer minor units (BRL scale 2). A JSON number or a digit string.

currency.description: Only BRL is accepted; anything else is `currency_must_be_BRL`.

SimulateOutcomeRequest.description: Sandbox only. Any body other than `{"status":"failed"}` settles the payment as completed.

reason.description: Stored as failure_reason when status is failed.

tx_hash.description: Crypto send only; a mock hash is generated when omitted.

CreatePixPayoutRequest.description: A session (dashboard) caller must supply `payout_account_id` — this call only initiates and shows the resolved receiver; confirm with POST /pix/payouts/{id}/confirm. An API-key caller must omit `payout_account_id` and supply `pix_key` directly; that single call holds and pays.

pix_key.description: Required unless `payout_account_id` is given (session callers) or the workspace is pinned to a settlement key.

payout_account_id.description: Session callers only; selects a saved PayoutAccount.

receiver_name.description: Checked against the provider-resolved receiver; a mismatch on name is not enforced, only on document.

receiver_document.description: CPF/CNPJ the caller expects to receive; mismatch with the resolved receiver is `receiver_document_mismatch`.

pix_key_type.description: Used only to match an approval-gate request, not validated server-side here.

approval_id.description: Links this payout to a previously approved multisig request.

PixPayoutFeeRequest.description: Both fields are optional digit amounts; omit either to get a 0 for it.

amount_minor.description: The amount a withdrawal would send.

budget_minor.description: The most the customer can debit; used to compute max_minor.

pix_key.description: Any PIX key type; a document key must be the party's own CPF/CNPJ.

side.description: Ignored. Recorded on the quote for reference only; the direction is always base_currency to quote_currency.

RfqQuoteRequest.description: You pay `base_amount_minor` of `base_currency` and receive `quote_currency`. To buy USDT with BRL: base BRL, quote USDT. To sell USDT for BRL: base USDT, quote BRL.

amount_minor.description: Integer minor units of currency (USDT/USDC scale 6).

to_address.description: Must fit the target network's address shape; cross-chain addresses are refused.

from_address.description: Must be one of the party's own wallets on `network`; omit to use its only wallet there.

payout_wallet_network.description: Only kept when it is one of the supported networks.

status.description: One of the valid party statuses.

url.description: https in production; http allowed only outside production. A private/loopback/link-local host (checked by string AND by resolved DNS at delivery time) is refused.

events.description: Event types to receive; omit or send empty for every event (`*`).

CreatePaymentLinkRequest.description: Either a fixed amount_minor, or allow_custom_amount=true for an open-amount page the buyer prices.

slug.description: Globally unique across every merchant; a random one is generated when omitted.

allow_custom_amount.description: Flipping to false on a link with no fixed price fails with price_required_for_fixed_amount.

party_id.description: Must already belong to the workspace when present.

share_bps.description: Basis points; the set's total must not exceed 10000.

payer_document.description: CPF or CNPJ, any formatting; validated as a real document number.

amount_minor.description: Required (and only used) on an open-amount link; a fixed-price link always charges its own price.

payer_document.description: CPF or CNPJ, any formatting; validated as a real document number.

amount_minor.description: Required (and only used) on an open-amount link.

allowed_ips.description: Plain IPs or CIDR ranges (IPv4/IPv6). Empty/omitted = no IP restriction.

permissions.description: Resources this key may call, e.g. ["pix", "wallets:read"]. Empty/omitted = full access.

UpdateApiKeyRequest.description: At least one of name, allowed_ips, permissions must be present.

settings.description: Merged (deep patch) into the stored settings; never replaces the whole document.

withdrawable_minor.description: BRL that can leave trading now; 0 while under review.

under_review.description: Ledger and provider proofs disagree: trading withdrawals are frozen.
